ItemID: NA; Title: MedPride Powder-Free Nitrile Exam Gloves, Small, Case/1000 (100 Count (Pack of 10)); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for a case of exam gloves, and small may not fit.
ItemID: NA; Title: DEWALT Finish Nails, 1-1/2-Inch, 16GA, 2500-Pack (DCS16150); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent nail purchases were for framing; these finish nails serve a different purpose and require compatible equipment.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gardner Bender SK-832T Electricians Screw Kit, 8-32 Round Phillips Head, 20 pc of ⅔, ⅞, 1, 1¼, 1 ⅝, & 2 in. Electrical Screws, 120 Pc. Kit; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for wood and mounting fasteners, with no immediate electrical screw need.
ItemID: NA; Title: #8 Deck Screws, Select Length in Listing, 18-8 Stainless Steel, Square Drive, Type 17 Wood Cutting Point, Quantity 100 (#8 x 2") by Fastenere; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These match my recent interest in 2-inch wood screws and look useful for outdoor fastening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Waterproof Caulk & Seal 100% Silicone Sealant, 10oz Cartridge, White (Pack of 6); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no immediate sealing task, so six cartridges would be an unnecessary purchase.
ItemID: NA; Title: Power Pro 48600 Wood Screws, #9 x 3", Premium Outdoor Deck Screws, Rust Resistant, Epoxy Coated Bronze, 1lb Box, 83 pcs; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: These closely match the outdoor screws I recently selected, with a shorter length that could complement my 4-inch screws.
ItemID: NA; Title: Senco A209909 18-Gauge-by-1-2-Inch Electro Galvanized Variety Pack Brads; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Brads do not meet the framing and heavier fastening needs suggested by my recent purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: BAVITE Heavy Duty Magnetic Hooks,100 LB（8pack） Strong Neodymium Magnet Hook for Home, Kitchen, Workplace, Office and Garage,32mm(1.26inch) in Diameter; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have been choosing screw-mounted hardware and have no specific use for magnetic hooks right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It could be handy for repairs, but I have no current bonding job that justifies buying it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Arrow BN1812BCS 18-Gauge Steel Brad Nails for Molding, Cabinets, Framing, Trim, and Finishing, Safe to Use with Electric or Battery Powered Nailers, 3/4 Inch, 2000 Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These short brads do not substitute for my recent framing nails, and I have no immediate trim project.
